question: If a creature with renown deals combat damage to its own controller because the damage was redirected, does renown trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: renown triggers even if the damage was dealt to its controller through redirection.
expected.answer: If a creature with renown deals combat damage to its controller because that damage was redirected, renown will trigger.
